# AITechPrep

> A visual-first technical interview learning site with direct answers, accessible visual explanations, practical examples, trade-offs, and a structured AI engineering learning roadmap.

AITechPrep publishes a focused library covering LLMs and generative AI, machine learning, MLOps, Python, data engineering, and system design. Each interview guide starts with a concise answer and distinguishes established concepts from limitations and context-dependent choices.

## Core pages

- [Question bank](/questions): interview answers and detailed learning guides.
- [AI Engineer learning roadmap](/roadmaps/ai-engineer-foundations): seven connected learning stages and topic pages.
- [Blog and news](/blog): technical explainers and dated reporting with source links.
- [About AITechPrep](/about): editorial and learning approach.

## Content notes

- News claims include dates and source references. An eligibility estimate is not a confirmed outcome.
- Structured data is intended to describe visible page content; it is not a guarantee of inclusion or ranking in search or answer engines.
